svg.title: Average power at 13.5 nm by source class
svg.desc: Average power at 13.5 nm by source class from 1 µW to 10 kW: tin laser-produced plasma in production at 250–600 W and demonstrated to 1 kW inside the shaded HVM band, discharge plasma at tens of watts, FEL and SSMB designs of 1 to 38 kW as hollow projections, FLASH at 20 mW and HHG at a microwatt.
